# Liquid Glass Filter

Vendored optical filter modules from
https://github.com/ObaidQatan/liquid-glass-component-library (master archive,
retrieved 2026-10-07). MIT license is preserved in `LICENSE`.

Archive SHA256: C1ADD3CBF9FE1688A08BC9E532659656C4DBD73C9D04F1B476BA3E9934B5BBC2.

Only the `kube` glass renderer is included. The original global theme provider
and demo UI are excluded so site themes and preferences retain ownership.
Local adaptations: guard displacement samples for strict TypeScript indexing;
remove lint directives for a plugin this repository does not use.
